stylists.title: Owner & Licensed Professional Hairstylist
stylists.bio: Rionna is a licensed professional hairstylist who brings the salon to you. From braids and crochet to loc retwists, kids' styles, and fresh cuts, she serves Brandon, Riverview, Tampa and surrounding areas. A $15 non-refundable deposit (applied to your service) secures your appointment — DM to check availability!

reviews.name: Shanice B.
reviews.text: Rionna came right to my house and did my knotless braids perfectly. So convenient and so professional!

reviews.name: Tamika R.
reviews.text: She did my daughter's braids and was so patient with her. Neat, cute, and they lasted for weeks.

reviews.name: Jerome W.
reviews.text: Fresh cut without leaving the house. On time, clean work, and great energy. Booking again for sure.

reviews.name: Kayla M.
reviews.text: My loc retwist looks amazing. Rionna really cares about the health of your hair. Highly recommend!
